speakers.description: The studio host, heard clearly in every turn.
A remote guest on the telephone during turns 2 through 4 only.

segments.speaker: alex
segments.text: Welcome to the studio. Our guest is joining us by telephone.

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: Hello Alex. Thank you for inviting me.

segments.speaker: alex
segments.text: Can you tell us what makes a good discussion?

segments.speaker: guest
segments.text: Listening carefully, and giving each person time to answer.

segments.speaker: alex
segments.text: Thank you. That is excellent advice.
